programme.title: One Strange Rock
programme.desc: A story about the creation and history of the planet, the laws governing it, its shape, the richness of flora and fauna, threats to the natural environment, natural wonders and surprising relationships.Actor Will Smith and people who have had the opportunity to spend time in space will talk about this extraordinary place in the universe.Accounts from astronauts including Mae Jemison, Mike Massimino, Leland Melvin and Chris Austin Hadfield will provide a completely new perspective on Earth.Director Darren Aronofsky and his film crew visited 45 countries and six continents.The photos were taken in, among others, the Arctic, the Himalayas, India and during the annual festival in Tarragona, Spain.Materials recorded on board the International Space Station were also used.In the following episodes, viewers will learn how oxygen is produced, the protective layers of the Blue Planet and the entire sequence of events that led to the creation of life.The topic of death, colonization, destruction, the search for alien forms and human intellect will also be discussed.

programme.title: The Wild Sides
programme.desc: The creators of the three-part series follow the fate of several families of wild animals living in the Mashatu reserve in Botswana.The production was created over two years and presents the fate of four species.Around the bed of the dried river there are a pride of lions, elephants, a leopard, jackals with offspring, and playful baboons.Every day, these creatures fight to survive and raise their offspring in difficult conditions, and their fates are inextricably linked.Macquele the leopard is a single mother who must deal with the presence of hyenas, lions and jackals, as well as a troop of baboons giving her away her position every time she hunts.A herd of elephants led by Ukwethemba searches for food and water, covering long distances.For the young Abancane elephant, life on the move is not easy.Jackals are monogamous.The male and female of this species raise their offspring together.To find food for them, they must face much larger predators.Baboons are smart, cunning and cause trouble wherever they go.Among them are Umusa and her son.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The Savute region, which is located in Botswana, can be both a benevolent paradise and an extremely brutal hell for animals.However, it will always be unpredictable.Covering an area of ​​three thousand square miles, the African savanna is home to competing clans of predators.The survival of lions, leopards, hyenas and wild deer depends on huge herds of their potential prey - buffaloes, elephants and zebras.Every day means a fight for survival, in which the law of nature is the most important.The series has six episodes, thanks to which viewers will be transported to the extraordinary world of animals.There, death can come without warning.Even the most powerful and seemingly invincible kings of the savannah do not know when their last day will come.Viewers will also see how changing weather conditions affect the carnivore clans.During the rainy season, young are born, drought means less food and a dramatic struggle for survival.

programme.title: America's National Parks
programme.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, a filmmaker and knowledge popularizer from Australia, begins his expedition through the most difficult corners of this continent.During the journey, he talks about animals that managed to master the art of survival.Each episode introduces three species and discusses their unique characteristics.From harsh deserts to seas to forests to rivers, Phil introduces viewers to a variety of ecosystems, showing which animals are best adapted to challenging environmental conditions.
